description: Generate a complete `item` document (form of `stance`) with summary and metadata elements. JSON outline here is useful, but any details in prompt instructions should override.
name: createStance

backgrounds.description: Background Influences (ethical, ideological, philosophical, etc.) related to `value`

content.description: Include entire, or snippets, original Member conversation regarding this `stance`

conviction.description: Conviction level of `stance` from 0-10, where 0 is no conviction and 10 is full conviction

emotional_intensity.description: Emotional intensity level of `stance` from 0-10, where 0 is no emotional intensity and 10 is high emotional intensity

form.description: MyLife System Form of `stance`; political-stance bots should use `political` form, all others should use `personal`

geography.description: Related geography and/or offices for `stance`, if applicable

keywords.description: Keywords most relevant to `stance`, include any relevant ideology, movement, or issue keywords for political stances

summary.description: A complete `stance` summary composed of all salient points and related points from member content

title.description: Generate display Title for `stance` based on content
